children: HONG YUAN HOLDING GROUP reported results for the second quarter of 2026, posting revenue of $32.16K, a net loss attributable to the company of $94.4K and diluted loss per share of $(0.0012), compared with revenue of $112.81K, net income of $30.04K and diluted EPS of $0.0004 in Q2 2025.
Revenue was $32.16K for Q2 2026, down from $112.81K in Q2 2025; YoY change (71.5%).
Net income: Net loss attributable to the Company was $94.40K for Q2 2026, versus net income $30.04K in Q2 2025.
Diluted EPS was $(0.0012) for Q2 2026, versus $0.0004 in Q2 2025.
Revenue declined significantly year-over-year, driven by reduced Chinese VIE sales and lower gross profit.
Company continues to focus on wholesale and internet channels for fast-moving consumer goods, including food, daily necessities and electronics.
Reorganization under common control completed: Hongyuan HK consolidated Fengcuiyuan and its subsidiaries.
Xuchang was deconsolidated in Q2 2025 after Rongcheng withdrew its 55% ownership; prior results are treated as discontinued operations.
Higher selling, general and administrative expenses — including personnel and public-company compliance costs — increased operating losses for the quarter.
